b: For today’s prompt, take the phrase “True (blank),” replace the blanks with a new word or phrase, make the new phrase the title of your poem, and then, write your poem. Possible titles might include: “True Crime,” “True Romance,” “True and False,” “True as the Rain Falling on Your Head,” and/or “True Stories to Tell Your Children.”
Remember: These prompts are springboards to creativity. Use them to expand your possibilities, not limit them.
